description: This file contains unit tests for the PersonUnvoidHandler class in the OpenMRS API. It tests the unvoiding functionality of Person entities, verifying that properties such as voided status, voided by, date voided, and void reason are correctly unset.

classes.name: PersonUnvoidHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for PersonUnvoidHandler, verifying unvoiding behavior of Person objects.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoidedBit
methods.description: Tests that the handle method unsets the voided status of a person.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoider
methods.description: Tests that the handle method clears the voided by user of a person.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonDateVoided
methods.description: Verifies that the handle method clears the date voided field.

methods.name: handle_shouldUnsetThePersonVoidReason
methods.description: Ensures that the handle method removes the void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldOnlyActOnAlreadyVoidedObjects
methods.description: Checks that the handle method does not alter persons who are not voided.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotActOnObjectsWithADifferentPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Verifies that handle does not modify a person if the date voided differs from the expected.
